description: This Dart file defines a Flutter widget called TagsPage, which provides a user interface for listing, creating, editing, and deleting tags within the application. It interacts with repositories to stream tag data and includes UI components such as dialogs, bottom sheets, and a list view.

classes.name: TagsPage
classes.description: A StatelessWidget that displays a list of tags with options to add, edit, or delete them. Handles user interactions and communicates with repositories to perform CRUD operations.

methods.name: _openCreate
methods.description: Navigates to the TagFormPage for creating a new tag.

methods.name: _openEdit
methods.description: Navigates to the TagFormPage for editing an existing tag.

methods.name: _showTagMenu
methods.description: Displays a bottom sheet menu with options to edit or delete a tag.

methods.name: _confirmDelete
methods.description: Shows confirmation dialog to delete a tag and performs cleanup of related tasks if confirmed.
